info.name: Referee - Match API
info.description: APIs used by authenticated referees for assigned tournament/match operations. Three separate tournament OTP phases: Toss (existing PUT /toss with otp on initial action), Match Start (/session/start), Match End (/session/end). Independent bookings do not use OTP.

request.description: Lists only STATUS_ACCEPTED (2) matches. STATUS_ASSIGNED (1) matches are not officiatable and only appear in /match-requests.

Always call GET Toss first to check `data.toss.state`. The state drives which UPDATE action is permitted next.

Roster: `data.teams[].members[]` returns `user_id`, `name`, `mobile_number`, `country_code`, `profile_image_url`, `is_captain`. Roster players expose `user_id` (authoritative id for all scoring/toss payloads), `name` (display label, never a phone number; fallback: profile full name -> team-player name -> users.name -> `Player #{user_id}`), and separate `mobile_number` / `country_code` (nullable, display only; returned only to the assigned referee).

request.description: Roster: `data.teams[].players[]` returns `user_id`, `name`, `mobile_number`, `country_code`; `data.scoring.runtime.current_*` objects carry the same identity. Roster players expose `user_id` (authoritative id for all scoring/toss payloads), `name` (display label, never a phone number; fallback: profile full name -> team-player name -> users.name -> `Player #{user_id}`), and separate `mobile_number` / `country_code` (nullable, display only; returned only to the assigned referee). The same enriched structure is returned by every successful `PUT /score`.

response.name: 200 Success
404 Match Not Found
401 Unauthorized

request.description:
Every successful response includes the same enriched roster (`data.teams[].players[]`: `user_id`, `name`, `mobile_number`, `country_code`). Payload ids (`striker_user_id`, `non_striker_user_id`, `bowler_user_id`, `wicket_keeper_user_id`, `player_id`, `dismissed_user_id`) must always be canonical `user_id` values - never names or mobile numbers.

**Permanent ledger (additive, backward compatible).** Every ADD_EVENT is also stored permanently in `tournament_player_score_events` in the same DB transaction as the score. Optional ADD_EVENT fields: `event_uuid` (UUID - retry key; a replay returns 200 with `data.recorded_event.replayed=true` and never scores twice; reuse for a different event = 409; legacy requests without it cannot be de-duplicated), `runs_source` (BAT | BYE | LEG_BYE, only for NO_BALL and RUN_OUT wickets, attributes the additional runs; omitted = recorded as unattributed), `fielder_user_id` (fielding-team player for run-outs/catches). UNDO_LAST accepts `reason` and returns `data.reversed_event` - the exact ledger row is marked reversed (never deleted). UNDO_LAST is only allowed while the match is LIVE. Note: the endpoint is `PUT /score` (not POST /score/actions).

response.name: COMPLETE
COMPLETE - Final (no downstream advancement)
COMPLETE - Group match (qualification pending)
COMPLETE - Advancement mapping missing
COMPLETE - Winner required (409)
COMPLETE - Target slot conflict (409)
COMPLETE - Unauthorized (401)
Validation Error (422)
409 Conflict - Next Action Required
ADD_EVENT - Idempotent replay (event_uuid already recorded)
ADD_EVENT - Recorded (ledger reference)
UNDO_LAST - Ledger event reversed
ADD_EVENT - event_uuid reused (409)
ADD_EVENT - Invalid runs_source (422)

item.name: Match Session OTP, Score Submission and Withdrawal

request.description: Readiness, started/ended OTP verification, no OTP hashes.
Use a Match Start OTP distinct from the Toss OTP. Requires completed toss and team/ground readiness. After successful session/start, PUT /score action START begins scoring.

item.name: Submit final score — pending End OTP

request.description: Validates result and saves final_submission = AWAITING_END_OTP; does NOT mark match COMPLETED.

item.name: Verify End OTP, finalize and progress

request.description: Verify the organizer End OTP issued automatically after successful final-score submission. Finalizes the tournament match and applicable tournament progression exactly once. Standalone booking matches do not use session OTP or settle a booking.

item.name: Withdraw submitted score and revoke End OTP

request.description: Allows score correction before OTP approval; revokes any existing end OTP.
